import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return first == p.first && second == p.second;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int)(first ^ (first >>> 32)) * 31 + second;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXT = 62;
    static long choose(int x, int y) {
        if (y > x || y < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            res = res * (x - i);
            res = res / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int R = sc.nextInt();
        int C = sc.nextInt();
        int T = 2 * R + 2 * C;
        char[] c = new char[T];
        String s = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            c[i] = s.charAt(i);
        }

        long[] lscore = new long[MAXT];
        long[] r1score = new long[MAXT + 1];
        long[] rscore = new long[MAXT + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXT; i++) lscore[i] = 0;
        lscore[2 * R - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * R; i < T; i++) {
            lscore[i] = lscore[i - 1] * i / (i - 2 * R + 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            r1score[i] = choose(i, R - 1);
            rscore[i] = choose(i, R);
        }

        long mval = 0;
        int acnt = 0, bcnt = 0;
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            boolean u = mval > 0;
            if (bcnt == T / 2) u = true;
            if (acnt == T / 2) u = false;
            if (u) {
                acnt++;
                mval -= r1score[T / 2 - acnt] * rscore[T / 2 - bcnt];
            } else {
                bcnt++;
                mval += r1score[T / 2 - bcnt] * rscore[T / 2 - acnt];
            }
        }
        mval = Math.max(mval, -mval);

        long tsum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) tsum += lscore[i];
        tsum = rscore[T / 2] * rscore[T / 2];

        Map<Pair, Long> mmap = new HashMap<>();
        mmap.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 2 * R - 1; i--) {
            Map<Pair, Long> nmap = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int acntKey = entry.getKey().second;
                long ncount = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T / 2 - acntKey;
                int bleft = i + 1 - aleft;

                long asum = sum + r1score[aleft - 1] * rscore[bleft];
                long bsum = sum - r1score[bleft - 1] * rscore[aleft];

                if (c[i] == 'A') {
                    Pair p1 = new Pair(asum, acntKey + 1);
                    nmap.put(p1, nmap.getOrDefault(p1, 0L) + ncount);
                } else if (c[i] == 'B') {
                    Pair p2 = new Pair(bsum, acntKey);
                    nmap.put(p2, nmap.getOrDefault(p2, 0L) + ncount);
                } else { // '?'
                    Pair p1 = new Pair(asum, acntKey + 1);
                    nmap.put(p1, nmap.getOrDefault(p1, 0L) + ncount);
                    Pair p2 = new Pair(bsum, acntKey);
                    nmap.put(p2, nmap.getOrDefault(p2, 0L) + ncount);
                }
            }
            tsum -= lscore[i];

            mmap.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : nmap.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int acntKey = entry.getKey().second;
                long ncount = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T / 2 - acntKey;
                int bleft = i - aleft;
                if (acntKey > (T / 2) || (T - i - acntKey) > (T / 2)) continue;
                long lsum = rscore[aleft] * rscore[bleft];
                if (sum < (-mval - lsum) || sum > (mval + lsum)) continue;
                Pair p = new Pair(sum, acntKey);
                mmap.put(p, mmap.getOrDefault(p, 0L) + ncount);
            }
        }

        long bscore = (long) 1e18;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            bscore = Math.min(bscore, Math.max(sum, -sum));
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            int acntKey = entry.getKey().second;
            long ncount = entry.getValue();

            if (sum == bscore || sum == -bscore) {
                int nleft = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 2 * R - 1; i++) {
                    if (c[i] == 'A') acntKey++;
                    if (c[i] == '?') nleft++;
                }
                ncount *= choose(nleft, T / 2 - acntKey);
                ans += ncount;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
